_comment: Tables the match server needs, as data files or generated table modules. Each is pinned by SHA-256; check-oss fails on any unlisted file under match/data/ or match/tables/, or on a changed hash. Re-pin only after reviewing the diff. None of these contains recorded traffic.

match/data/learned-floor-seed-204.json.source: walkable positions learned from our own test matches

match/data/netlayout.json.source: replication field order of engine/game classes, from the game executable

match/data/spawnpoints-204.json.source: spawn actor locations from the game's map files

match/data/sv-funcflags-204.json.source: function flags from the game executable's reflection data

match/data/sv-replayout-204.json.source: replication layouts from the game executable's reflection data

match/data/usmap-enums-204.json.source: enum names and values from the game's type mappings

match/tables/hero-kits.ts.source: ability grant rows per hunter (from the game's cooked hero assets and flown tests) + the FireFox grant decoded from recorded matches

match/tables/instance-policy.ts.source: ability instance replication policy and per-hunter attribute maxima
